1. Open the tidyverse library.
```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
```
2. Open the starwars dataset.

```{r}
data(starwars)
```


3. Create a subset of data that contains only the humans from the starwars franchise.

```{r}
humans_starwars<- subset(starwars, starwars$species == "Human")
```

4. In this subset of data, who is the tallest character?

```{r}
humans_starwars #print

#The tallest character is Darth Vader with 202
```

5. In this subset of data, print the information about the character in the third row.
```{r}
row3_subset<- humans_starwars[3,]
row3_subset

```


6. In the full starwars dataset, calculate the average mass for the masculine characters.

```{r}
gender_starwars<- subset(starwars, starwars$gender == "masculine")
gender_starwars
#summary(gender_starwars) #Double-checked
summary(gender_starwars$mass)
#Average (Mean) mass for the masculine is 106.5
```


7. Create a dataset that contains only the characters and the films that they appeared in from the full dataset.

#I assume that the question asked to create a new dataset that only contains information of chatacters and films (whihc is 2 columns).

```{r}

#library(tidyverse)
characters_and_film <- starwars |> select(name, films) 
characters_and_film #print
```



8. Create a new column in the starwars dataset that contains a "ranking" of all characters (Note: you don't have to actually rank them. Just fill the column in with the numbers 1-87)

```{r}
starwars$ranking<- NA #created a new column
starwars$ranking<- c(1:87) #put numbers 1-87 in rows
```



9. Create a subset of data for the characters from Naboo. How many characters are from Naboo?
```{r}
characters_from_Naboo<- subset(starwars, starwars$homeworld == "Naboo") #crated a new subset
characters_from_Naboo #print
#How many?: 11 characters are from Naboo.
```



10. How many droids are in the full dataset?
```{r}
droids_starwars<- subset(starwars, starwars$species == "Droid")
droids_starwars
summary(droids_starwars)

#How many droids?: 6 droids.(length is 6 in summary or checked the table directly after creating the subset)
```
